title: commitwork monitor slice (v1)
description: One historically-accurate slice of insight through the fleet: what was scanned (scope), at what code state (anchors), with what tooling (toolRuns), what was found (findings), what could not be known (carried), and what verifiably changed (delta/counts + remediation-ledger.json). v1 slices are evolved history/ snapshots; v0 snapshots (no sliceVersion) predate scope+provenance gating and are known-ambiguous.

sliceId.description: canonical id, e.g. sweep-<stamp> or adhoc-<stamp>; no trailing dots

capabilities.description: What the box could DO when this slice was swept — a legitimacy fact, not a result. docker 'down' means container lanes (deps-osv among them) are structurally void and this slice's zeros are voids; liveness degrades a fresh slice on it. 'absent' is a deliberate reduced deployment; 'unrecorded' is the pre-field vintage and must never be read as up or down.

generated.description: when the rollup ran — NOT the code state; see anchors

source.description: batch report dir this slice was rolled from

scope.description: INTENDED scan population; toolRuns records what ACTUALLY ran. Resolution requires both.

anchors.description: code-state anchors per repo: {path, sha, branch, dirty}; sha null = not a git checkout

toolRuns.description: per-repo provenance: checks-status.json contents (enum pass|fail|skip|noscan; noscan = the check ran but produced no trustworthy output — a void, distinct from a clean pass) + artifact presence for the CVE parsers. Absence of a finding only means something if its tool provably ran. THE AUTHORITY FOR THIS ENUM IS monitor/check-vocabulary.mjs (CHECK_STATUS) — this description is prose no validator enforces, so if the two ever disagree the module is right and monitor/test/check-vocabulary.test.mjs will say so.

enrichmentRefs.description: frozen per-slice KEV/EPSS subsets (this slice's CVE ids only); epss null = no score known, distinct from 0.0

totals.description: RAW scan counts (consumer contract — unchanged semantics from pre-v1 rollups)

openTotals.description: accepted-aware counts: findings without an active annotation

scanned.description: denominators: repos scanned / intended, per-tool coverage — a count is only meaningful next to these

delta.description: 'fixed' = verified cleaned (one vocabulary with the ledger); pre-v1 snapshots' delta.fixed was ungated and unreliable

key.description: repo|tool|id|package|path — stable across version bumps that don't fix

annotation.description: active human judgment as-of this slice's time

carried.description: prior findings whose repo/tool was NOT scanned this slice — state unknown-not-scanned, excluded from totals, rendered grey (never counted fixed)

resolved.description: prior findings gone this slice: resolved-fixed (evidence-backed) | resolved-unconfirmed (weak) | resolved-accepted | resolved-scope

checks.description: non-CVE check outcomes per repo (lint/test/build-health/... from checks-status.json)
